description: Answers 'same person?' for two contacts, as the contact pane's shared-line chip and the card's Related people do: action related (different people who legitimately share a line: spouses, family, a household, an assistant, coworkers) with relation, or action not_duplicate (two different people who happen to share a line; duplicate suggestions for the pair stop everywhere). otherClientId is the other contact (read entity clients). Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; the verdict is an upsert, so a repeat changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: record_client_relationship
title: Say two contacts are related, or different people
